sentences.en: The doctor examined the child and said she was healthy.
sentences.zh: 医生检查了这个孩子，说她很健康。

sentences.en: We have to appoint new members of the examining board.
sentences.zh: 我们必须任命新的考试委员会成员。

sentences.en: They found out truth while examining a pile of relevant documents.
sentences.zh: 他们在审查大量相关文件时发现了真相。
